d:
"Tip Tip Barsa Paani" is one of the most iconic and popular rain songs in Bollywood, featured in the 1994 film Mohra. The song became an instant hit due to its catchy rhythm, passionate lyrics, and unforgettable performances by the lead actors Akshay Kumar and Raveena Tandon.
